CBOR: Throw on truncated unknown byte/text strings skipped with ignoreUnknownKeys

ByteArrayInput.skip() advanced the input position past the end of the
input when a skipped (unknown) byte string or text string declared more
bytes than remained, so decoding with ignoreUnknownKeys = true silently
accepted truncated input instead of failing.

skip() now throws CborDecodingException when the number of bytes to skip
exceeds the remaining input, matching how other truncated CBOR input is
rejected (see CborParser.ensureEnoughBytes).

Signed-off-by: Rene Turcios <95189389+CloudCorpRecords@users.noreply.github.com>
